draft_review.summary: The bounded song passes all supplied machine checks. It lasts exactly 8 seconds at 120 BPM, has eight audible notes across five pitches, and its rising-then-falling melody returns to its opening pitch. The evidence supports that it is runnable with Play and Stop controls.
draft_review.improvement: Add a brief rest after the highest note to make the turn from ascent to descent easier to hear while keeping the total duration at 8 seconds.

final_review.summary: The final chime is useful and understandable as a short reset cue: its melody rises, pauses at the peak, then returns to the opening pitch. Supplied deterministic checks pass, and the evidence supports that it is playable with Play and Stop controls. The total duration remains exactly 8 seconds at 120 BPM, with eight audible notes across five distinct pitches.
final_review.improvement: Make the breath audible by lengthening the rest after the high note and shortening another note by the same amount, keeping the total duration exactly 8 seconds.
